title: Bit decoding on embedded bits
statement: Let $\Gamma$ be a type with decidable equality and let $e:\{0,1\}\hookrightarrow\Gamma$ be an embedding. For every bit $b$, the decoder that returns true exactly on $e(1)$ sends $e(b)$ to $b$.
hypotheses_covered: An embedding $e$ of the Boolean alphabet into $\Gamma$
replaced:
Let $e : \{0,1\} \hookrightarrow \Gamma$ be an embedding of the bits into an alphabet
$\Gamma$. For every bit $b$, applying the total bit decoder (which sends $a \in \Gamma$
to $1$ exactly when $a = e(1)$) to $e(b)$ returns $b$.
